Mo'ataan filannoo kanaa kunis filannoo guddicha kan ji'a Sadaasaa irratti kaadhimamtuu paaritii Dimokiraata kan taate Aanii Andreews waliin kan dorgomu ta'a.

title: DRC Ebola death toll passes 2,000 amid fastest-growing outbreak on record
english: The Democratic Republic of Congo is facing its most rapid Ebola outbreak ever, with confirmed deaths surpassing 2,000. Over 4,300 cases have been reported across five provinces, fueled by challenges such as misinformation, cultural burial practices, and health worker strikes. While vaccine trials are currently in progress, there is no verified treatment yet for this specific strain of the virus.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራሲያዊ ሪፐብሊክ እስካሁን ካጋጠማት እጅግ ፈጣን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ጋር እየታገለች ሲሆን፣ የሟቾች ቁጥርም ከ2,000 አልፏል። በአምስት ግዛቶች ውስጥ ከ4,300 በላይ በበሽታው የተያዙ ሰዎች የተመዘገቡ ሲሆን፣ የተሳሳቱ መረጃዎች፣ ባህላዊ የቀብር ሥነ-ሥርዓቶች እና የጤና ባለሙያዎች አድማ ወረርሽኙን ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ አድርገውታል። ምንም እንኳን የክትባት ሙከራዎች እየተካሄዱ ቢሆንም፣ ለዚህ የኢቦላ ዝርያ እስካሁን የጸደቀ መድኃኒት የለም።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebola saffisaan babal'achaa jiru lubbuu namoota 2,000 ol galaafatee jira. Godinoota shan keessatti namoota 4,300 ol irratti kan mirkanaa'e yoo ta'u, odeeffannoo dogoggoraa, aadaa awwaalchaa fi sochii hojjettoota fayyaa irratti gufuun mudate to'annoo dhibichaa ulfaataa taasisee jira. Qorannoon talaallii osoo gaggeeffamaa jiruus, dhibee kanaaf qorichi ykn talaalliin dhugoomfame hanga ammaatti hin jiru.

title: East Libya military intelligence chief killed in car bomb
english: Major-General Fawzi al-Mansouri, the head of military intelligence for eastern Libya, was killed in a car bombing in Benghazi. The attack occurred when an explosive device detonated as he entered his vehicle outside his home. Eastern Libyan officials have condemned the assassination and promised to investigate the perpetrators of this violent act.
amharic: የምስራቅ ሊቢያ የጦር መረጃ ዋና ሃላፊ የሆኑት ሜጀር ጀነራል ፋውዚ አል-ማንሱሪ በቤንጋዚ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የመኪና ቦምብ ጥቃት ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ጄነራሉ ከቤታቸው ውጭ ወደ መኪናቸው ሲገቡ በተጠመደ ፈንጂ ነው። የምስራቅ ሊቢያ ባለስልጣናት ግድያውን አውግዘው፣ ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙትን ወንጀለኞች በህግ ፊት እንደሚያቀርቡ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan sitti-himaa waraanaa kan Baha Libiyaa kan ta'an Mejer Jeneraal Fawzi al-Mansuurin, magaalaa Bengaazii keessatti boombii konkolaataa irratti hidhamee tureen ajjeefaman. Ajjeechaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo isaan mana isaanii duratti konkolaataa isaanii seenaa turanitti boombiin sun dhohee dha. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Baha Libiyaa gocha kana balaaleeffachuun, yakka kana kan raawwatan qaamolee seeraaf akka dhiyeessan waadaa galaniiru.

title: Israel pursuing ‘undeclared annexation’ of West Bank, Peace Now says
english: The advocacy group Peace Now has accused the Israeli government of effectively annexing parts of the West Bank by expanding its administrative control into areas previously managed by Palestinians. By increasing military and civilian authority over regions under the Oslo Accords, the group argues that officials are violating international agreements to seize more land. This shift in policy allows Israeli agencies to intervene in Palestinian construction and urban planning, threatening long-standing territorial arrangements.
amharic: ፒስ ናው የተባለው ቡድን የእስራኤል መንግስት በዌስት ባንክ የነበሩ የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር ስልጣኖችን በመቀማት በይፋ ያልታወጀ ወረራ እያካሄደ ነው ሲል ከሰሰ። መንግስት በኦስሎ ስምምነት መሰረት በፍልስጤማውያን ቁጥጥር ስር በነበሩ አካባቢዎች የራሱን ሲቪል እና ወታደራዊ አስተዳደር በማስፋፋቱ አለም አቀፍ ስምምነቶችን እየጣሰ ነው ብሏል። ይህ ድርጊት እስራኤል በፍልስጤም መሬት ላይ ተጨማሪ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል እንደሆነ ቡድኑ ገልጿል።
oromo: Jaarmayaan ‘Peace Now’ jedhamu, mootummaan Israa’el naannoo Qarqaraa (West Bank) keessatti aangoosaa babal'isuun lafa biyyoota biroo qabatamaa akka jiru himateera. Mootummaan kun walii galtee Oslo cabsuun, aangoosaa naannoo ummanni Palastayinii bulchaa ture keessatti dirqiin babal'isaa jiraachuu gabaasichi ibsa. Tarkaanfiin kun ijaarsaafi karoora magaalaa Palastayinii keessa seenuuf kan gargaaruufi lafa dabalataa to'achuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu gabaasni kun ni addeessa.

title: Qatar says Oman-Iran talks on Hormuz in advanced stage
english: A Qatari official recently announced that negotiations between Oman and Iran regarding maritime security in the Strait of Hormuz have reached an advanced phase. These discussions focus on determining the future of shipping operations through this critical waterway. The update highlights ongoing regional efforts to ensure stability in the area.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ ውስጥ ስላለው የመርከብ ጉዞ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ በኦማን እና በኢራን መካከል የሚደረገው ድርድር ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን የኳታር የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ውይይቶች በስትራቴጂካዊው የባህር መስመር ላይ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ በቀጠናው መረጋጋትን ለመፍጠር እየተደረጉ ያሉ ጥረቶችን ያሳያል።
oromo: Mootummaan Qatar akka beeksisetti, mariin biyyoota Oman fi Iran gidduutti karaa bishaan Hormuz irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru sadarkaa gaarii irra ga'eera. Mariin kun gara fuulduraatti karaa daldala galana kanaa tasgabbeessuu fi nageenya isaa eeguurratti kan xiyyeeffatu dha. Kunis naannichatti nagaa fi tasgabbii buusuuf carraaqqii taasifamaa jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
english: Former President Donald Trump secretly switched aircraft while departing a NATO summit in Turkey last month to avoid a potential Iranian missile threat. He reportedly used a catering truck to sneak onto a smaller military plane while his staff and the media remained unaware on his original jet. This complex maneuver allowed him to reach the UK safely before ultimately returning to the United States.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ባለፈው ወር በቱርክ በተካሄደ የኔቶ ጉባኤ ወቅት፣ ከኢራን ሊሰነዘር ይችላል በተባለ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ለመትረፍ ሚስጥራዊ የአውሮፕላን ቅያሬ አድርገዋል። በዘገባው መሰረት፣ ዋናው አውሮፕላን ላይ እንደገቡ በማስመሰል በምግብ ማመላለሻ መኪና አማካኝነት በድብቅ ወደ ሌላ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ተዛውረዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የፕሬዝዳንቱ ሰራተኞች እና ጋዜጠኞች ሳይረዱት የተፈጸመ ሲሆን፣ ትራምፕ ደህና ሁኔታ ላይ ሆነው ጉዞአቸውን ወደ እንግሊዝ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii duraanii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp ji'a darbe biyya Turkii keessatti yaa'ii Naattoo booda, sodaan weerara mizaayilaa Iraan waan tureef xiyyaara isaanirra jiran gara biraatti akka geeddaran gabaasameera. Traamp xiyyaara gurguddaa keessa seenuuf qophii erga godhatanii booda, akka tasaa konkolaataa nyaata fe'uun gara xiyyaara waraanaa xinnootti akka darban himameera. Haalli kun ogeessota mana mootummaa fi gabaastota biratti dhokataa waan tureef, Traamp nagaadhaan biyya Ingiliz ga'anii gara Ameerikaatti deebi'uuf danda'aniiru.

title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claims that Russia is now utilizing North Korean ballistic missiles to conduct deadly attacks on Ukrainian cities, including a recent strike in Zaporizhzhia that caused several casualties. In retaliation, Ukraine continues to target critical Russian infrastructure deep within its territory, including industrial plants and warehouses. Zelensky warns that this military cooperation with North Korea not only escalates the conflict but also poses a growing global security threat.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ከተሞች ላይ ለሚሰነዘሩ ገዳይ ጥቃቶች የሰሜን ኮሪያ ባለስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን እየተጠቀመች እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። በምላሹም ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኙ ወሳኝ የኢንዱስትሪ ተቋማት እና መጋዘኖች ላይ ጥቃት ማድረሷን ቀጥላለች። ዘለንስኪ ይህ ከሰሜን ኮሪያ ጋር ያለው ወታደራዊ ትብብር ግጭቱን ከማባባሱም በላይ ለአለም አቀፍ ደህንነት ትልቅ ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimiir Zeeleniskii, Raashiyaan magaalonni Yukreen irratti haleellaa ajjeesaa raawwachuuf misaa'ela biyya Koree Kaabaa fayyadamaa akka jirtu ibsaniiru. Kana dura Zaappooriizhiyaa keessatti haleellaa raawwatameen namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Karaa biraatiin, Yukreenis bakkee gurguddaa Raashiyaa fi bakkeewwan oomishaalee gubuu ishee itti fuftee jirti. Zeeleniskii hariiroon waraanaa Koree Kaabaa waliin uumame kun rakkoo biyyattii qofa osoo hin taane, nageenya addunyaafis balaa guddaa akka ta'e akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
english: A Syrian court has sentenced former leader Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia for war crimes and crimes against humanity committed during his rule. Assad, who fled to Russia in December 2024 following his regime's collapse, was convicted alongside his cousin, Atef Najib, who received the same sentence. While the new Syrian government is pursuing justice for the victims of the civil war, it remains uncertain if Russia will agree to extradite the ousted dictator.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን መሪ በሻር አል አሳድ በስልጣን ዘመናቸው በፈጸሙት የጦር ወንጀል እና የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት በሌሉበት የሞት ቅጣት ፈረደባቸው። አሳድ የዘመናቸው ስርዓት በታህሳስ 2024 ከወደቀ በኋላ ወደ ሩሲያ የሸሹ ሲሆን፣ አብረዋቸው የተፈረደባቸው የአጎታቸው ልጅ አቴፍ ናጂብም ተመሳሳይ ፍርድ ተላልፎባቸዋል። አዲሱ የሶሪያ መንግስት ለተጎጂዎች ፍትህ ለመስጠት እየሰራ ቢሆንም፣ አሳድን ከሩሲያ አሳልፎ ማምጣት ይቻል እንደሆነ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Mana murtii Suuriyaa duraanii Baashar al-Asaad ajjeechaa fi yakka waraanaa raawwataniin bakka hin jirreetti adabbii du'aa itti murteesseera. Asaad sirni isaanii erga kufee booda bara 2024 gara Raashiyaa kan baqatan yoo ta'u, fira isaanii Ateef Naajiib jedhamus adabbii walfakkaatuun itti murteeffameera. Mootummaan Suuriyaa haaraan miidhamtootaaf haqaa kennuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiruus, mootummaan Raashiyaa Asaad dabarsee akka kennu abdii guddaan hin jiru.

title: Libyan authorities battle big blaze at major oil refinery
english: A major fuel refinery in Zawiya, Libya, was struck by a drone attack, causing a massive fire that destroyed a large fuel tank. While no serious injuries were reported, the National Oil Corporation is now considering halting operations due to this repeated violence. These attacks underscore the ongoing political instability and division within the country.
amharic: በሊቢያ ዛዊያ ከተማ በሚገኝ ዋና የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ በደረሰ የድሮን ጥቃት ትልቅ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። ጥቃቱ የነዳጅ ማጠራቀሚያ ታንከርን ሙሉ በሙሉ ያወደመ ሲሆን፣ በሰዎች ላይ የከፋ ጉዳት ባይኖርም የነዳጅ ኮርፖሬሽኑ ቀጣይ የደህንነት ስጋቶችን በመፍራት የማጣሪያ ጣቢያውን ስራ ለማቆም እያሰበ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በሊቢያ ውስጥ ያለውን የረጅም ጊዜ አለመረጋጋት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Buufata qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa guddaa Zawiyaa, Liibiyaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaan xiyyaara nama malee (drone) gaggeeffameen ibidni guddaan ka'eera. Haleellaa kanaan taankiin boba'aa guddaan tokko kan barbadaa'e yoo ta'u, miidhaan qaamaa cimaan nama irra ga'uu baatus, dhaabbanni boba'aa biyyattii nageenyaa fi walitti fufiinsa haleellichaatiif sodaachun hojii dhaabuuf karoorsaa jira. Haleellaan kun tasgabbii dhabuu fi gargar bahiinsa biyyattii keessa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Who is Atef Najib, former Syrian official sentenced to death with al-Assad?
english: A Damascus court has sentenced former security official Atef Najib to death for his role in the 2011 crackdown on protesters in Deraa. Najib, a cousin of the ousted Bashar al-Assad, was found guilty of serious offenses including murder, torture, and crimes against humanity. While Bashar and Maher al-Assad received the same sentence in absentia, Najib is currently being held in custody within Syria.
amharic: የደማስቆ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞ የፀጥታ ሃላፊ የነበሩትን አቴፍ ናጂብ በ2011 በዴራ በሰላማዊ ሰልፈኞች ላይ በወሰዱት የኃይል እርምጃ ምክንያት በሞት እንዲቀጡ ወስኗል። ከተገለበጡት የሶሪያ መሪ ባሻር አል-አሳድ ጋር ዝምድና ያላቸው አቴፍ ናጂብ፣ ግድያን፣ ስቃይን እና በሰው ልጆች ላይ የተፈጸሙ ወንጀሎችን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ከባድ ክሶች ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። ባሻር እና ማሄር አል-አሳድ በሌሉበት የሞት ቅጣት ቢበየንባቸውም፣ ናጂብ ግን በአሁኑ ወቅት በሶሪያ ውስጥ በእስር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii Damasqoo, aanga'aa nageenyaa duraanii Ateef Naajiib jedhaman irratti, bara 2011 magaalaa Deeraa keessatti hiriira bahanii turan irratti tarkaanfii fudhatameef adabbii du'aa murteesseera. Ateef Naajiib, kanneen aangoo irraa bu'an Baashar Al-Asaad waliin dhihoo kan walitti hidhatan yoo ta'u, ajjeechaa, dararaa fi yakka namoomaa irratti raawwatame jedhamuun himatamanii turan. Baashar fi Maahir Al-Asaad adabbii du'aa kana kan argatan bakka hin jirretti ta'us, Naajiib garuu yeroo ammaa kana biyya Siiriyaa keessatti hidhaa keessa jiru.

title: Bangladesh and India battle to save cricket series after political turmoil
english: Bangladesh and India are currently working at a high government level to rescue an upcoming six-match cricket series that was previously delayed. Relations between the two countries have been strained since the 2024 political uprising in Bangladesh that led to the ousting of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Officials are now holding diplomatic talks to resolve the deadlock and restore sporting ties between the neighbors.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ እና ህንድ ከዚህ ቀደም ተስተጓጉሎ የነበረውን ስድስት ጨዋታዎችን ያካተተ የክሪኬት ውድድር ለማካሄድ በከፍተኛ የመንግስት ደረጃ ድርድር እያደረጉ ነው። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት የተበላሸው እ.ኤ.አ በ2024 በባንግላዲሽ በተቀሰቀሰው ህዝባዊ አመጽ የቀድሞዋ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ በኋላ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይቶች እየተካሄዱ ያሉት ውዝግቡን በማርገብ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የስፖርት ግንኙነት ለማደስ ነው።
oromo: Bangladeshiifi Indiyaan tapha kriketii taphni ja'a keessatti argamu kan kanaan dura ture deebisanii jalqabuuf gargaarsa mootummaan mari'achaa jiru. Walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota lamaanii kan hir'ate, bara 2024tti Bangladeshitti jijjiirama siyaasaa mudateen booda yeroo muummee ministiraa duraanii Sheek Haasiinaan aangoo irraa bu'an irraa kaaseeti. Amma mootummootni lamaan walii galtee uumuun taphoota kana deebisanii fiduuf marii dippilomaasii geggeessaa jiru.

title: The Global South’s digital future must not belong to Bezos and Musk
english: Amazon’s satellite internet is expanding into rural Africa, following the rapid growth of Elon Musk’s Starlink in developing regions. While these services promise to connect underserved communities, there are significant concerns about long-term reliance on powerful foreign corporations that are closely linked to US national interests. Experts warn that allowing private tech giants to control critical digital infrastructure could give them excessive influence over the economies and political systems of developing nations.
amharic: የአማዞን የሳተላይት ኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት፣ የኤሎን መስክ ስታርሊንክን ተከትሎ በአፍሪካ ገጠራማ አካባቢዎች እየተስፋፋ ይገኛል። እነዚህ አገልግሎቶች የተገለሉ ማህበረሰቦችን የማገናኘት አቅም ቢኖራቸውም፣ ከአሜሪካ ብሔራዊ ጥቅም ጋር የተሳሰሩ ግዙፍ የውጭ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ጥገኛ መሆን አሳሳቢ ነው። የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ወሳኝ የዲጂታል መሠረተ ልማቶችን መቆጣጠራቸው በታዳጊ ሀገራት ኢኮኖሚ እና ፖለቲካ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ሊፈጥር እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Tajaajilli intarneetii saatalaayitii kan Amazon, kan Elon Musk Starlink jedhamu hordofuun naannolee baadiyaa Afrikaa keessatti babal'achaa jira. Tajaajiloonni kunniin hawaasa tajaajila hin arganne wal qunnamsiisuuf abdii kan kennan ta'us, dhaabbilee alaa humna qabanii fi fedhii biyya Ameerikaa wajjin walitti hidhata qaban irratti hirkachuun sodaa guddaa qaba. Dhaabbileen tekinooloojii gurguddoon bu'uuraalee misoomaa dijitaalaa to'achuun isaanii, dinagdee fi sirna siyaasaa biyyoota guddataa jiran irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumuu akka danda'u ogeeyyiin akeekkachiisu.

title: Iraq’s semi-autonomous Kurdish region suffers as US-Iran war drags on
english: The semi-autonomous Kurdistan region of Iraq is facing severe consequences from the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran. Despite maintaining neutrality, the region has endured over 1,000 missile and drone attacks that have damaged infrastructure and caused casualties. These hostilities have crippled the local economy, resulting in a 70 percent drop in trade and over a billion dollars in financial losses.
amharic: የኢራቅ የኩርዲስታን ክልል በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው ግጭት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። ክልሉ ገለልተኛ ቢሆንም፣ ከ1,000 በላይ የሚሆኑ የሚሳይል እና የድሮን ጥቃቶች ደርሰውበታል፤ ይህም ለሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና ለንብረት ውድመት ምክንያት ሆኗል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የንግድ ልውውጥን በ70 በመቶ በመቀነሳቸው ክልሉ ከ1 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የኢኮኖሚ ኪሳራ አጋጥሞታል።
oromo: Naannoon Kordistaan kan Iraaq waraana Ameerikaa, Israa'elii fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiruun miidhaa guddaa keessa jira. Naannoon kun waraana keessa akka hin galle yoo ibse iyyuu, roorroo fi haleellaa dhooyitii fi 'dronii' 1,000 ol ta'een miidhaan guddaan qaamaa fi qabeenyaa irra ga'eera. Haleellaa kanaan wal-qabatee daldalli naannichaa gara dhibbeentaa 70n gadi bu'uu fi miidhaan dinagdee doolaara biliyoona tokkoo ol akka ga'e gabaasameera.

title: Vietnam’s VinSpace announces deal with SpaceX to launch first satellite
english: The Vietnamese aerospace company VinSpace has signed a contract with SpaceX to launch its debut satellites in early 2027. This partnership will allow the firm to test its internally developed technology in orbit while working to build a commercial space industry in Vietnam. Owned by billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong, VinSpace aims to integrate the country into the global space market by managing its own satellite operations.
amharic: የቬትናሙ የጠፈር ምርምር ድርጅት ቪን ስፔስ (VinSpace) የመጀመሪያ ሳተላይቶቹን በ2027 መጀመሪያ ላይ ወደ ጠፈር ለመላክ ከኤሎን መስክ ስፔስ ኤክስ (SpaceX) ጋር ስምምነት ተፈራርሟል። ይህ ትብብር ኩባንያው በራሱ ያዘጋጀውን ቴክኖሎጂ በጠፈር ውስጥ እንዲሞክር እና በቬትናም የጠፈር ንግድ ዘርፍን እንዲገነባ ያስችለዋል። የቢሊየነሩ ፋም ንሃት ቩኦንግ ንብረት የሆነው ቪን ስፔስ፣ የሳተላይት ስራዎችን በራሱ በመምራት ቬትናምን በአለም አቀፍ የጠፈር ገበያ ውስጥ ለማስገባት አቅዷል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni qorannoo hawaa Vi'etnaam 'VinSpace' jedhamu, satalaayitoota isaa jalqabaa bara 2027 keessa gara hawaatti erguuf dhaabbata Elon Musk kan ta'e 'SpaceX' waliin waliigalteerra ga'eera. Tumsi kun dhaabbatichi teeknoolojii ofiin qopheeffate hawaa keessatti akka qoruufi industirii daldala hawaa Vi'etnaam keessatti akka babal'isu isa gargaara. Abbaan qabeenyaa biyyattii Pham Nhat Vuong kan ta'e 'VinSpace', hojii satalaayitii ofiin hogganuun Vi'etnaam gabaa hawaa addunyaa keessatti qooda akka qabaattuuf carraaqaa jira.

title: Court sentences Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia in landmark trial
english: A Syrian court has issued a death sentence for former president Bashar al-Assad, his brother, and a top security official. They were found guilty of serious crimes, including the intentional killing of children, torture, and crimes against humanity. While the official was present for the trial, Assad and his brother were sentenced in absentia as they have fled the country.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ባሻር አል-አሳድን፣ ወንድማቸውን እና ሌላ ከፍተኛ የፀጥታ ባለስልጣን በሞት እንዲቀጡ ወስኗል። ግለሰቦቹ ህጻናትን በመግደል፣ በማሰቃየት እና በሰብአዊነት ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ወንጀሎችን በመፈጸም ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። የፀጥታ ባለስልጣኑ በችሎት ቢገኙም፣ አል-አሳድ እና ወንድማቸው ከአገር በመውጣታቸው ብይን የተሰጠባቸው በሌሉበት ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Suuriyaa duraanii pirezidaantii Baashaar al-Asaad, obboleessa isaa fi qondaala nageenyaa ol’aanaa tokko irratti murtee du’aa dabarseera. Namoonni kunniin ijoollee ajjeesuu, dararuu fi yakka namummaa irratti raawwatamuun himatamuun isaanii mirkanaa’eera. Qondaalli nageenyaa kun mana murtii kan argame yoo ta’u, Asaad fi obboleessi isaa biyyaa baqachuu isaaniitiin murtiin kun kan darbe isaan bakka hin jirreetti.

title: Colombia recognises Israeli sovereignty over Golan Heights
english: Colombia’s new president, Abelardo de la Espriella, has officially recognized Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights, marking a significant shift from his predecessor's policies. This move makes Colombia only the second nation, after the United States, to support Israel's control of the territory. The Israeli government welcomed the decision, citing it as vital for their national security and defense.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያው አዲሱ ፕሬዚዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ እስራኤል በጎላን ኮረብታ ላይ ያላትን ሉዓላዊነት በይፋ እውቅና ሰጥተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ከቀድሞው አስተዳደር ፖሊሲ በመውጣት ኮሎምቢያ ከአሜሪካ ቀጥላ የጎላን ኮረብታን የእስራኤል ግዛት አድርጋ በመቀበል ሁለተኛዋ ሀገር ሆናለች። የእስራኤል መንግስት ይህ ውሳኔ ለሀገራቸው ደህንነት እና መከላከያ ወሳኝ ነው በማለት ምስጋናውን አቅርቧል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Kolombiyaa haaraan, Abelardo de la Espriella, labsii mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Golan Heights irratti qabu beekkamtii kennan. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii aangoo duraa irraa garaagarummaa guddaa kan mul'isu yoo ta'u, Kolombiyaan Ameerikaatti aansuun biyya lammaffaa naannoo kana irratti aangoo Israa'el fudhatte taateetti. Mootummaan Israa'el murtee kana eeguun nageenya fi ittisa biyya isaaniitiif murteessaa dha jechuun galata galchaniiru.

title: UKMTO reports incident involving military in Gulf of Oman
english: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency has reported a security incident in the Gulf of Oman involving a tanker and military personnel. The organization has issued an official warning to vessels operating in the region as they investigate the situation. Authorities have not yet provided specific details regarding the nature of the encounter or the identity of the military forces involved.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የባህር ንግድ ኦፕሬሽንስ ኤጀንሲ በኦማን ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ በታንከር መርከብ እና በወታደራዊ ኃይሎች መካከል የተፈጠረ የደህንነት ችግር መኖሩን አስታውቋል። ተቋሙ በአካባቢው ለሚንቀሳቀሱ መርከቦች የጥንቃቄ ማስጠንቀቂያ የሰጠ ሲሆን ጉዳዩን እየመረመረ እንደሚገኝ ገልጿል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ስለ ግጭቱ ሁኔታ ወይም ስለ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎቹ ማንነት እስካሁን ምንም ዓይነት ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም።
oromo: Hojii Daldala Galaana UK kan ta'e (UKMTO), baha galaana Omaan keessatti markaba boba'aa fe'u fi humnoota waraanaa gidduutti rakkoon nageenyaa uumamuu isaa gabaaseera. Dhaabbatichi qorannoo geggeessaa akka jiru ibsuun, markaboota naannicha keessa jiran hundaaf akeekkachiisa dabarseera. Haata'u malee, humni waraanaa kun eenyu akka ta'e ykn rakkoon kun maal akka ta'e hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane.

title: Brent oil price passes $90 as Iran-US deal hopes fade
english: Global oil prices have risen above $90 per barrel as negotiations between the United States and Iran regarding conflict resolution have stalled. Tensions increased after both nations made conflicting financial demands for war reparations, dimming prospects for a peaceful agreement. This geopolitical instability has caused energy costs to climb significantly over the past week.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስምምነት ተስፋ በመሟጠጡ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከአንድ በርሜል 90 ዶላር በላይ ከፍ ብሏል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት ለጦርነት ካሳ አንዳቸው ከሌላው የገንዘብ ክፍያ በመጠየቃቸው ውጥረቱ እየተባባሰ ሄዷል። ይህ የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት ባለፉት ሳምንታት የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲጨምር ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Hirmaannaa fi mariin biyyoota Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhamaa ture waan hin milkoofneef gatiin boba'aa kuta tokkoo ykn baarel tokkoon 90 doolaara ol darbeera. Biyyoonni lameen kun kaffaltii beenyaa waraanaa wal gaafachuu isaaniitiin wal dhabbiin isaanii hammaatee jira. Rakkoon siyaasaa kun immoo torbanoota darban keessa gatiin boba'aa akka ol ka'u taasiseera.

title: Rescue efforts intensify as quake devastates western Colombia towns
english: A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake has struck western Colombia, resulting in at least 132 deaths and thousands of missing persons. Emergency responders and local residents are currently searching through the debris of over 1,600 collapsed buildings to find survivors. The government has mobilized the military and received international aid to assist the hardest-hit, isolated regions.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በደረሰ ከባድ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 132 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩም የት እንዳሉ አይታወቅም። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እና የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች የፈራረሱ ህንጻዎችን በመቆፈር የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። መንግስት ወታደራዊ ሃይልን በማሰማራት ከአለም አቀፍ አጋሮች እርዳታ በመቀበል በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች የነፍስ አድን ስራውን አጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti lafti socho’uun balaa cimaa gahe kanaan namoonni 132 ol yoo du’an, kumaatamaan kan lakkaa’aman immoo bakka buutee isaanii dhabameera. Humnoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa fi jiraattonni naannichaa, iddoo manni itti diigame keessatti namoota lubbuun hafan barbaaduuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Mootummaan raayyaa ittisaa bobbaasuun akkasumas gargaarsa idil-addunyaa argachuun naannolee balaan cimaan gahe deeggaraa jira.

title: Swiatek to face Svitolina in Canadian Open semifinal
english: Iga Swiatek secured her spot in the Canadian Open semifinals with a dominant victory over Diana Shnaider. She will now face Elina Svitolina, who reached this stage after completing a comeback win against Ekaterina Alexandrova. This match is a significant milestone for Swiatek as she looks to regain her form ahead of the upcoming US Open.
amharic: ኢጋ ስዋይቴክ ዲያና ሽናይደርን በማሸነፍ የካናዳ ኦፕን የሴሚፎናል ምዕራፍ ላይ ደርሳለች። በሴሚፎናሉ የዩክሬኗን ኤሊና ስቪቶሊናን የምትገጥም ይሆናል፤ ስቪቶሊና ወደዚህ ደረጃ የደረሰችው ኤካቴሪና አሌክሳንድሮቫን በመርታት ነው። ስዋይቴክ ወደፊት በሚካሄደው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር ላይ ጥሩ ብቃት ለማሳየት ይህ ድል ትልቅ አስተዋፅኦ ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Iga Swiatek injifannoo salphaa Diana Shnaider irratti argachuun gara semi-fayinaalii kaanaadaa Opanii darbiteetti. Semi-fayinaalichatti, Ekaterina Alexandrova injifattee kan dhufe Elina Svitolina waliin kan wal morkatan ta'a. Injifannoon kun Swiatek dorgommii Yuu Es Opanii dhufuuf qophii gaarii akka gootuuf gargaaruu danda'a.

title: What to know about the US primaries in Connecticut, Vermont, and Alabama
english: Voters in Connecticut, Vermont, and Alabama are heading to the polls for primary elections to select candidates for the upcoming November midterms. In Connecticut, Governor Ned Lamont faces a progressive challenger named Josh Elliott in a race focused on tax and fiscal policy. Meanwhile, Alabama is holding special primary elections for U.S. House seats following a redrawing of the state's electoral district map.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኮነቲከት፣ የቨርሞንት እና የአላባማ ግዛቶች ለህዳር ወር አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ተወዳዳሪዎችን ለመለየት የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫቸውን እያካሄዱ ነው። በኮነቲከት፣ አሁን በስልጣን ላይ ያሉት ገዢ ኔድ ላሞንት ከጆሽ ኤሊዮት ጋር የውስጥ ፓርቲ ውድድር እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ውድድሩም በታክስ እና በኢኮኖሚ ፖሊሲዎች ዙሪያ ያጠነጠነ ነው። በአላባማ ደግሞ የምርጫ ክልሎች ካርታ ከተቀየረ በኋላ ለአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት እጩዎችን ለመምረጥ ልዩ ምርጫ እየተካሄደ ነው።
oromo: Filattoonni biyyoota Ameerikaa kanneen akka Konektikat, Vermoont fi Alaabaamaa, filannoo guddicha kan Sadaasaa kahuuf murtii kennuuf qophiirra jiru. Konektikat keessatti, guvernarri amma jiran Ned Lamont fi morkataan isaanii Josh Elliott siyaasa diinagdee fi taaksii irratti xiyyeeffachuun wal dorgomaa jiru. Alaabaamaa keessattis, kaartaan naannoolee filannoo erga jijjiiramee booda, bakka buutota Mana Maree Ameerikaaf dorgomtoota filachuuf filannoon addaa gaggeeffamaa jira.

title: ‘My father is in RSS’: India’s Gen Z confronts Modi-loving parents at home
english: Young Indians from families supporting the ruling BJP party are increasingly challenging their parents' political views by joining mass protests against the government. These Gen Z activists are demanding significant education reforms following nationwide scandals involving leaked exam papers. This generational divide is creating unprecedented domestic tension as youth activists reject the ideology of the RSS, which serves as the ideological foundation for the current administration.
amharic: በህንድ ውስጥ የአገሪቱን ገዥ ፓርቲ የሚደግፉ ቤተሰቦች ያሏቸው ወጣቶች፣ በወላጆቻቸው የፖለቲካ አመለካከት ላይ በመቃወም በአገሪቱ እየተካሄዱ ባሉ ተቃውሞዎች ላይ እየተሳተፉ ይገኛሉ። የዘመኑ ወጣቶች (Gen Z) በተለይም የፈተና ጥያቄዎች መሰረቃቸውን ተከትሎ በትምህርት ስርዓቱ ላይ ሰፊ ማሻሻያ እንዲደረግ እየጠየቁ ነው። ይህ የአመለካከት ልዩነት፣ ወጣቶች ለገዥው መንግስት መሰረት የሆነውን የRSS ርዕዮተ ዓለም በመቃወማቸው በቤተሰቦች መካከል ከፍተኛ መለያየትን እያስከተለ ነው።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti dargaggoonni maatiin isaanii paartii biyya bulchu BJP deeggaran, ilaalcha siyaasaa maatii isaanii mormuun hiriira mormii biyyoolessaarratti hirmaachaa jiru. Dargaggoonni kun gabaa qormaataa waliin walqabatee rakkoo uumameen walqabatee sirna barnootaa keessatti jijjiirama barbaadu. Walitti buutiin ilaalchaa kun, dargaggoonni dhaabbata RSS kan biyyattii bulchaa jiruuf bu'uura ta'e mormuu isaaniitiin maatii keessatti waldhabdee guddaa uumaa jira.

title: Bashar al-Assad, Atef Najib sentenced to death in landmark Syria trial
english: A Syrian court has handed down death sentences to former president Bashar al-Assad and former security official Atef Najib. They were found guilty of premeditated murder and crimes against humanity stemming from their actions during the 2011 uprising in Deraa. Additionally, Najib was convicted for his role in the torture of citizens during the civil war.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ባሻር አል-አሳድን እና የደህንነት ኦፊሰር የነበሩትን አተፍ ናጂብን በሞት ቀጣ። ሁለቱም በ2011 በደራ ግዛት በተካሄደው ግጭት በሰው ልጆች ላይ ለፈጸሙት ወንጀል እና ለታቀደ ግድያ ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። ናጂብ በተጨማሪም በዜጎች ላይ ድብደባ እና ማሰቃየት በመፈጸሙ ተጨማሪ ክስ ቀርቦበታል።
oromo: Mana murtii Suuriyaatti pirezidaantii duraanii Bashar al-Assad fi hoggansaa nageenyaa Atef Najib irratti adabbii du'aa murteesseera. Isaan kun bara 2011 magaalota Deraa keessatti yakka namoomaa fi ajjeechaa karooraan raawwatameef itti gaafatamtoota ta'uun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Kana malees, Najib namoota hidhatanii turan irratti dararama fi reebicha raawwachuun isaa mirkanaa'eera.

title: Syria: Court sentences Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia in landmark trial
english: A Syrian court has sentenced former leader Bashar al-Assad, his brother Maher, and former official Atef Najib to death for crimes against humanity, including torture and murder. While Najib faced the court in person, the Assad brothers were tried in absentia as they currently reside in Moscow. This historic ruling marks the first major legal action taken by the nation's new transitional government against the former regime.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን መሪ በሽር አል-አሰድን፣ ወንድማቸውን ማህርን እና የቀድሞ ባለስልጣን አቴፍ ናጂብን በግድያ፣ በስቃይ እና በሰው ልጆች ላይ በተፈጸሙ ወንጀሎች ጥፋተኛ ብሎ በመፍረድ የሞት ቅጣት አስተላለፈባቸው። ናጂብ በፍርድ ቤት በአካል የተገኙ ቢሆንም፣ አሰድ እና ወንድማቸው በአሁኑ ጊዜ ሞስኮ ውስጥ ስለሚገኙ በሌሉበት ነው ብይን የተሰጠባቸው። ይህ ውሳኔ የሀገሪቱ የሽግግር መንግስት በቀድሞው አስተዳደር ባለስልጣናት ላይ የወሰደው የመጀመሪያው ታሪካዊ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Suuriyaa dura ta'aa biyyattii Bashar al-Asaad, obboleessa isaa Maher fi hoggansaa duraanii Atef Najib irratti himata ajjeechaa fi dararaa raawwataniin du'a murteesseera. Najib mana murtii irratti kan argame yoo ta'u, obboleewwan Asaad garuu ammaan tana magaalaa Moskoo waan jiraniif bakka hin jirretti murtiin kun irratti darbeera. Murtiin seena qabeessi kun mootummaa cehumsaa biyyattiin hoggantoota sirna duraanii irratti tarkaanfii seeraa kan jalqabaa fudhateedha.

title: Two wounded in Israeli drone attack in Lebanon
english: Two civilians were injured in Nabatieh, Lebanon, following a drone strike conducted by Israel. A subsequent attack damaged an ambulance operated by the Al-Risala Association while emergency workers were transporting a victim. The Lebanese health ministry confirmed these incidents occurred on Tuesday.
amharic: በሊባኖስ ናባቲህ ከተማ በእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሲቪሎች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎም የተጎዱ ሰዎችን ለማጓጓዝ የሞከረ የአል-ሪሳላ ማህበር አምቡላንስ ላይ ሌላ ጥቃት ደርሶ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። የሊባኖስ የጤና ሚኒስቴር ማክሰኞ ዕለት እንደገለጸው የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሠራተኞች ለተጎጂዎች እርዳታ ለመስጠት ሲሞክሩ ነበር ይህ የተፈጠረው።
oromo: Magaalaa Naabatiye kan Libaanoos keessatti weerara xiyyaara kashilaa (drone) Israa'eliin raawwatameen namoonni nagaa lama madaa'aniiru. Hojjattoonni fayyaa namoota madaa'an wal'aanuuf yeroo gargaarsatti jiranitti, ambulaansii dhaabbata Al-Risaala irra weerarri lammaffaan raawwatamee miidhaan irra ga'eera. Ministeerri fayyaa Libaanoos akka ibsetti, miidhaan kun guyyaa Kibxata darbe akka raawwatame mirkaneesseera.

title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopia’s upcoming constitutional reforms are challenging the long-standing assumption that Amhara politics occupies the center of the nation's power structure. The transition from the old coalition-based system to the Prosperity Party's majoritarian model means political influence is now determined by regional population size rather than equal representation. This shift effectively moves Amhara political interests from the core to the periphery, forcing a major reassessment of their traditional role in Ethiopian governance.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የሕገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን የአማራ ፖለቲካ በአገሪቱ ማዕከል የመሆን አመለካከት እየፈተነው ነው። አሁን ያለው የብልጽግና ፓርቲ ሥርዓት በሕዝብ ቁጥር ላይ የተመሠረተ የፖለቲካ ውክልናን በመከተሉ፣ የአማራ የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ከማዕከል ወደ ዳር እየተሸጋገረ ይገኛል። ይህ ለውጥ የአማራ የፖለቲካ ልሂቃን በአገሪቱ አወቃቀር ውስጥ ያላቸውን ባህላዊ ሚና እንደገና እንዲገመግሙ እያስገደዳቸው ነው።
oromo: Fooyya'iinsi seer-bu’uuraa Itoophiyaa kan ammaa kun, siyaasni Amaaraa giddu-galeessa mootummaa Itoophiyaa keessatti bakka guddaa qabaachuu qaba kan jedhu ilaalcha durii irratti dhiibbaa uumee jira. Sirni mootummaa ammaa kan Paartii Badhaadhinaa, dhiibbaa siyaasaa lakkoofsa ummataa irratti kan hundaaye waan ta’eef, gaheen siyaasa Amaaraa giddu-galeessa irraa gara qarqaraatti akka siqu taasisaa jira. Jijjiiramni kun hayyoonni siyaasa Amaaraa gahee isaan Itoophiyaa keessatti qaban irra deebi'anii akka yaadan isaan dirqisiisaa jira.

title: Mass grave with 25 bodies found in Sudan’s Kurmuk after army retakes town
english: Sudanese military forces recently discovered a mass grave containing at least 25 bodies in the town of Kurmuk. Local officials have blamed the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces for these killings, noting that the victims included women, children, and hospital staff. This disturbing find occurred as the army continues to clear the area following their successful recapture of the town from rebel control.
amharic: የሱዳን ጦር በኩርሙክ ከተማ ቢያንስ 25 አስከሬኖች የሚገኙበት የጅምላ መቃብር ማግኘቱን አስታውቋል። የከተማዋ አስተዳዳሪዎች ግድያው የተፈጸመው በራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርስ አማፂ ቡድን እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ የተገኘው የጅምላ መቃብር የሴቶች፣ የህጻናት እና የሆስፒታል ሰራተኞች አስከሬኖችን እንደያዘ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ግኝት የተመዘገበው ጦሩ ከተማዋን ከተቆጣጠረ በኋላ ባደረገው የፍተሻ ስራ ነው።
oromo: Humnooni waraana Sudaan magaalaa Kurmuk keessatti awwaala faachaa 25 ol qabate tokko argachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Hojjettooni mootummaa naannichaa ajjeechaa kanaaf kan itti gaafatamuu qaban humnoota Rapid Support Forces (RSF) ta'uu ibsanii, awwaalichatti keessatti reeffa dubartoota, ijoollee fi hojjettoota hospitaala akka argaman eeraniiru. Qorannoon kun kan godhame waraanni Sudaan magaalattii to'annoo isaa jala oolchuu isaatiin booda hojii sakatta'iinsa taasifameen dha.

title: Donald Trump says replacing Gianni Infantino would be a ‘terrible mistake’
english: US President Donald Trump has publicly supported FIFA President Gianni Infantino, warning that removing him from office would be a serious error. Infantino is currently facing strong criticism and calls for his resignation from major football confederations following a controversial attempt to privatize parts of the World Cup. Despite this backlash, Trump praised Infantino’s leadership, claiming that his departure would harm the future success and profitability of the organization.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የፊፋው ፕሬዚዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖን በግልጽ በመደገፍ፣ ከኃላፊነታቸው እንዲነሱ ማድረጉ ትልቅ ስህተት እንደሆነ ገለጹ። ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን በከፊል ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ባቀረቡት አወዛጋቢ ዕቅድ ምክንያት ከበርካታ የዓለም እግር ኳስ ማህበራት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ሆኖም ትራምፕ የኢንፋንቲኖን አመራር በማድነቅ፣ ከስልጣናቸው መውረድ የድርጅቱን ስኬት እና ገቢ ይጎዳል ብለዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp pirezidaantii FIFA Jaanii Infaantiinoo akka deggeran ibsanii, bakka isaanii buusuun dogoggora hamaa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Infaantiinoon erga sagantaa waancaa addunyaa qooda isaa dhuunfaatti gurguruuf yaalanii booda, waldaalee kubbaa miilaa gurguddoo irraa ceephoo cimaa mudataniiru. Kana hunda osoo jiru, Tiraampin hojii Infaantiinoo galateeffachuun, yoo isaan aangoo gadi lisan bu'aan FIFA fi galii inni argatu akka xiqqaatu ibsaniiru.

title: Russian attacks kill six in Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia
english: A series of Russian missile and drone strikes across Ukraine resulted in at least six deaths and several injuries, including damage to a children's hospital in Kyiv. Regional authorities reported massive destruction in the Zaporizhzhia area, while Ukraine responded with drone attacks in Russia that killed one person. These intensifying military operations highlight an escalation in long-range aerial warfare between the two nations.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ከተሞች በፈጸመችው የሚሳኤልና የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ በርካታ ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ በኪዬቭ የሚገኝ የህፃናት ሆስፒታልን ጨምሮ በዛፖሪዝሂያ አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። በምላሹ ዩክሬን በሩሲያ የቮሮኔዝ ክልል ባደረሰችው የድሮን ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ማለፉን የክልሉ አስተዳደር አስታውቋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት እያደረጉት ያለው የአየር ጥቃት በተጠናከረ መልኩ መቀጠሉ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humni Raashiyaa magaalota Yukreenii fi naannoo Zaaporizhiiyaatti miiseelaa fi dooniiwwaniin haleellaa raawwateen namoonni ja'a ajjeefamanii, kan biroo hedduun madaa'aniiru. Haleellaa kanaan hospitaalli ijoollee kan Maqdishoo (Kyiv) keessatti argamu miidhaan irra ga'eera. Yukreenis gama ishiitiin naannoo Woroneez kan Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa doonii raawwattee namni tokko yoo du'u, gochi kun wal-waraansa qilleensa irraa kan lamaan gidduutti godhamu daran hammaachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Iran to increase gas production, says state minister
english: Iran plans to boost its natural gas output by 95 million cubic metres by late September. This effort follows repair work on energy facilities that were previously damaged by international strikes. The country is working to recover production levels that dropped significantly due to ongoing conflicts.
amharic: ኢራን በሴፕቴምበር ወር መጨረሻ የጋዝ ምርቷን በ95 ሚሊዮን ኪዩቢክ ሜትር ከፍ ለማድረግ አቅዳለች። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ቀደም ሲል በደረሰባቸው ጥቃት ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው የኢነርጂ መሠረተ ልማቶች ከተጠገኑ በኋላ ነው። አገሪቱ በግጭቶች ሳቢያ ቀንሶ የነበረውን የምርት መጠን ወደ ቀድሞ ሁኔታው ለመመለስ ጥረት እያደረገች ነው።
oromo: Iiraan dhuma ji'a Fulbaanaatti oomisha gaazii ishee meetira kiyuubikii miliyoona 95'n dabaluuf karoorfatteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame bu'uuraalee misoomaa anniisaa miidhaan irra ga'ee ture erga suphaman boodadha. Biyyattiin walitti buiinsa keessa jirtuun oomishni ishee hir'atee ture gara duriitti deebisuuf tattaaffii gochaa jirti.

title: Israel's 'pilot zones' turn Lebanese sovereignty on its head
english: A U.S.-brokered agreement has introduced 'pilot zones' in southern Lebanon, where the Lebanese army is tasked with taking control as Israeli forces withdraw. Critics argue this plan undermines Lebanese sovereignty by allowing Israel to dictate the terms of security in areas it has heavily damaged. The initiative is being widely condemned as a farce, given Israel's history of occupation and the ongoing conflict that has caused massive destruction in the region.
amharic: በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የተፈረመው ስምምነት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ 'ሙከራ ቀጠናዎችን' በመፍጠር የሊባኖስ ጦር አካባቢውን እንዲቆጣጠር የሚያስችል ዕቅድ ይዟል። ይሁን እንጂ ስምምነቱ እስራኤል በራሷ ፍላጎት የሊባኖስን ሉዓላዊነት እንድትወስን ስለሚፈቅድ የሀገሪቱን ነፃነት የሚጥስ እንደሆነ ተችቷል። እስራኤል ቀደም ሲል በፈጸመችው ወረራ እና አሁን ባደረሰችው ከፍተኛ ውድመት ሳቢያ፣ ይህ ዕቅድ ከእውነታ የራቀ እና ተቀባይነት የሌለው እንደሆነ እየተገለጸ ይገኛል።
oromo: waliigalteen Ameerikaan giddu galeessa taatee mallatteessite, kutaa kibba Libaanoos keessatti 'iddoowwan qormaataa' uumuudhaan waraanni Libaanoos akka to'atu taasiseera. Ta'us, sagantaan kun Israa'el fedhii ishee akka irratti feetuuf karaa banuudhaan bilisummaa biyyattii kan tuqu ta'uun isaa qeeqameera. Israa'el seenaa weeraraa qabduufi miidhaa hamaa geessiste sana ilaaluudhaan, tattaaffiin kun dhugaa irraa fagaatee fi fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Morning update
english: Libya's oil infrastructure faced drone attacks, leading the National Oil Corporation to warn of potential refinery closures if violence persists. Meanwhile, Houthi forces targeted a Yemeni port with missiles, and a high-ranking Libyan military intelligence official was killed in a car bombing. Additionally, President Trump indicated that any peace discussions with Iran would be linked to compensation for American soldiers, while keeping the possibility of future military escalation open.
amharic: የሊቢያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት በድሮን ጥቃት የተደረገባቸው ሲሆን፣ የነዳጅ ኮርፖሬሽኑ ጥቃቱ ከቀጠለ ስራ ለማቆም እንደሚገደድ አስታውቋል። በሌላ በኩል የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ወደብ ላይ ሚሳይል የከፈቱ ሲሆን፣ በሊቢያ ደግሞ ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ባለስልጣን በመኪና ቦምብ ተገድለዋል። የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በበኩላቸው፣ ከኢራን ጋር የሚደረግ ማንኛውም የሰላም ድርድር ለሞቱ አሜሪካውያን ወታደሮች ካሳ ከመክፈል ጋር የተያያዘ እንደሚሆን በመግለጽ ተጨማሪ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ሊወሰድ እንደሚችል ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Bu'uuraalee misooma boba'aa Liibiyaa irratti weerarri tiroonii gaggeeffamuun isaa waldaan boba'aa biyyattii weerarichi kan itti fufu taanaan hojii dhaabuuf akka dirqaman beeksisaniiru. Gamasa biraatiin, gareen Huutii buufata doonii Yaman irratti miisaayilii kan dhukaase yoo ta'u, Liibiyaa keessattis ajajaan basaasotaa olaanaan tokko boombii konkolaataa irratti hidhamee tureen ajjeefamaniiru. Preezdaantii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp gamasaaniin, mariin nagaa Iraan waliin godhamu kamiyyuu kafaltii beenyaa loltoota Ameerikaa du'aniif kan kennamu ta'uu fi tarkaanfiin waraanaa gara fuulduraa kan hin oolle ta'uu himaniiru.

title: Report: Israel withholding 1,700 Palestinian bodies for future exchange deals
english: A recent report indicates that Israel is currently holding the remains of approximately 1,700 Palestinians to potentially use as leverage in future prisoner swaps. While this practice is permitted under Israeli law, it faces strong criticism from human rights organizations and violates international humanitarian standards regarding the dignified burial of the deceased. This policy continues despite claims that there are no remaining Israeli captives currently held by Hamas.
amharic: አንድ አዲስ ዘገባ እንደሚያመለክተው እስራኤል ለወደፊት የልውውጥ ስምምነቶች ለመጠቀም በማሰብ ወደ 1,700 የሚጠጉ ፍልስጤማውያን አስከሬኖችን ይዛ ትገኛለች። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ተግባር በእስራኤል ህግ የተፈቀደ ቢሆንም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች ይህ ድርጊት አለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ ህጎችን የሚጥስ እና የሟቾችን ክብር የሚነካ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ይቃወሙታል። ይህ ፖሊሲ እየተካሄደ ያለው ሀማስ እስረኞችን እንደያዘ በማይነገርበት ሁኔታ ውስጥ መሆኑም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa tokko akka ibsutti, Israa'el gabaa jijjiirraa booji'tootaa fuulduraaf akka meeshaa dhiibbaaatti fayyadamuuf reeffa Palastinoota 1,700 ta'an qabattee jirti. Gochi kun seera Israa'el keessatti kan heyyamame ta'us, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa garuu seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsuu fi kabaja reeffaa kan tuqu ta'uu isaa dubbatu. Haalli kun kan itti fufe, gareen Hamaas yeroo ammaa booji'amtoota Israa'el akka hin qabanne erga ibsamee boodas.

title: Yemen’s Houthis launch ballistic missile attacks on al-Makha and Marib
english: Houthi forces have launched a new series of ballistic missile strikes targeting the port city of Al-Makha and residential areas in Marib. These attacks follow a deadly assault on Al-Makha just one day earlier that resulted in multiple fatalities and significant damage. This recent surge in violence marks a dangerous escalation in Yemen's civil war as hostilities between the Houthis and the government continue to intensify.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በአል-ማካ ወደብ ከተማ እና በማሪብ መኖሪያ አካባቢዎች ላይ ተከታታይ የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃቶችን አድርሰዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ከአንድ ቀን በፊት በአል-ማካ ከተማ በደረሰ እና የሰባት ሰዎችን ህይወት በገበረው አሰቃቂ ጥቃት ተከትሎ የመጡ ናቸው። ይህ በየመን የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት የታየው የቅርብ ጊዜ የጥቃት ጭማሪ በሁቲዎች እና በመንግስት መካከል ያለው ግጭት ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni Huutii magaalaa buufata doonii Al-Makhaafi bakkeewwan jireenyaa Marib keessatti haleellaa miisa'elaa balistii kanneen biroo geggeessaniiru. Haleellaan kun guyyaa tokko dura Al-Makhatti namoota torba ajjeeseefi miidhaa guddaa geessise sanaan walqabata. Daballiin haleellaa amma mudate kun waraana Yemen keessatti hammaachuu fi lolli gidduu warra Huutiifi mootummaa gidduu jiru daran gubachaa jiraachuu argisiisa.

title: Somali referee arrives for UEFA Super Cup after World Cup exclusion
english: Somali referee Omar Artan is set to become the first official from outside Europe to manage the UEFA Super Cup match between PSG and Aston Villa. This milestone follows a frustrating period for Artan, who was previously prevented from officiating at the World Cup despite having proper travel documentation. His selection for this prestigious match marks a significant return to the global football stage.
amharic: የሶማሊያው ዳኛ ኦማር አርታን በፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርሜን እና በአስቶን ቪላ መካከል የሚደረገውን የዩኤፋ ሱፐር ካፕ ጨዋታ በመምራት ከአውሮፓ ውጪ የመጀመሪያው ዳኛ በመሆን ታሪክ ይሰራሉ። ይህ ሹመት የተሰጠው ቀደም ሲል ህጋዊ ቪዛ ቢኖረውም በዓለም ዋንጫው ላይ እንዳይሳተፍ ከተደረገ በኋላ ነው። ይህም ለዳኛው ትልቅ ዓለም አቀፍ እውቅና ነው።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa Somaaliyaa Omar Artan, tapha UEFA Super Cup kan PSG fi Aston Villa gidduutti godhamu kan taphachiisu yoo ta'u, kunis abbaa seeraa Awurooppaa hin taane isa jalqabaa isa taasisa. Mudannoon kun kan ta'e, duraan viizaa sirrii qabaatee utuu jiruu tapha Waancaa Addunyaarratti akka hin hirmaanne erga dhoorkamee booda. Filannoon kunis ogummaa isaa fi seenaa isaa keessatti tarkaanfii guddaadha.

title: Family watches helplessly as Colombia quake destroys home
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck Colombia, leaving a family to watch in despair as their house was leveled by the tremors. The disaster has resulted in over 130 confirmed deaths, with many others still missing or suffering from injuries. Rescue efforts are ongoing as the full extent of the destruction across the region becomes clear.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በደረሰ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ አንድ ቤተሰብ ቤታቸው ሲፈርስ በዓይናቸው ለማየት ተገደዋል። በአደጋው ከ130 በላይ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ሲሆን፣ በርካቶች ደግሞ የደረሱባቸው ስላልታወቀ ፍለጋው ቀጥሏል። የደረሰው ጉዳት በጣም ሰፊ በመሆኑ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየተከናወኑ ይገኛል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa keessatti kirkirri lafaa guddaan hanga 7.4 ta'u mudatee, maatiin tokko immoo mana isaanii akka diigamu ijaan arguuf dirqamaniiru. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 130 ol darbuun mirkanaa'ee jira; namoonni hedduun immoo bakka bu'aan isaanii hin beekamu. Miidhaan kun baay'ee waan ta'eef, hojiin gargaarsaafi barbaaddii namoota badee itti fufee jira.

title: Trump’s media company reports $238m loss
english: Donald Trump's media company, which manages Truth Social, reported a net loss of $238 million for the second quarter of 2026. While the company saw a slight increase in revenue from advertising and subscriptions, its losses were largely driven by poor performance in its digital asset investments. Despite branching out into new services like cryptocurrency and data subscriptions, the company's expenses continue to far exceed its total earnings.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሚዲያ ኩባንያ በ2026 ሁለተኛ ሩብ ዓመት ውስጥ 238 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ ኪሳራ እንዳጋጠመው አስታውቋል። ኩባንያው ከማስታወቂያ እና ከደንበኝነት ምዝገባዎች የተወሰነ ገቢ ቢያገኝም፣ አብዛኛው ኪሳራ በዲጂታል ንብረት ኢንቨስትመንቶች ምክንያት የመጣ ነው። አዳዲስ የንግድ ዘርፎችን ለመቀላቀል ቢሞከርም፣ የኩባንያው ወጪ ከሚያገኘው ገቢ በእጅጉ የላቀ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Kampaanin miidiyaa Doonaald Traamp kan Truth Social bulchu, ji'oota sadii darban keessatti doolaara miliyoona 238 ol akka harka baase beeksiseera. Galiin isaa beeksisaafi gurgurtaa tajaajilaa irraa xiqqoo dabaluus, kasaaraan isaa guddichi invastimantiiwwan diijitaalaa irratti qabu irraa kan madde dha. Hojiilee haaraa akka kiriptoo-kaarentii fi tajaajila odeeffannoo irratti bobba'us, baasiiwwan kampaanichaa galii isaa irraa baay'ee ol ta'anii jiru.
